description: A migration creates a new workspace-scoped table with a workspace_id foreign key, but never enables Row Level Security or defines any policy on it.

required_findings.exploit_preconditions: Any authenticated (or, depending on default grants, anon) caller reachable through the Data API — RLS is the only per-row tenant boundary this schema defines, and it was never enabled on this table.

explanation: This is the plain, unambiguous version of §3.10's RLS-disabled finding — the table is clearly tenant-scoped (a workspace_id FK, a comment even calls out the missing statement), and there is genuinely no RLS anywhere in this file. Distinct from fixture database-02 (not yet implemented in Phase 1's first ten), which tests the opposite false-positive: RLS *enabled* with zero policies on a table that's meant to be service-role-only, which is the correct deny-all pattern and must not be flagged the same way.
